note: Salt study, nicl2. Input rule: each species is entered in the form it exists in water under the study conditions, and max_deprotonations says how far it may go below that form. NiCl2: chloride as [Cl-], 0 deprotonations (HCl does not exist in water, pKa ~ -6). tHQ listed first (reuse between the two salts), up to 2 deprotonation(s). Ni(II) high-spin; square-planar excluded because d8 Ni(II) there is low-spin and only high-spin is modelled.
